reviews.x: Had wrote a good review but made sure to come back and update actually used for 2 times and loved it I was about to use it for my 3rd time and it just didn’t want to turn on anymore and I’m very upset !

reviews.t: Drill is super awesome! And the hidden gift which is the ...
reviews.x: Drill is super awesome! And the hidden gift which is the second picture definitely was a great surprise. Very happy. Follow up 2020 my drill died but it lasted 3 years so again very good buy

For those crafty and mechanically inclined this is great. I have been a salon frequenter for years. I now do my own powder dip (LIKE SNS, Red Carpet Color Dip, Kiara Sky) and use this to break the sealant before removal, to shape my nail and buff if after removing the powder acrylic, and to shape the powder dip after application. Use with caution, and START WITH LOW SPEED and move up. Not much instruction is included so I recommend reading more about how to use each drill bit/head
Great price and great quality. First time doing my nails at home and this did not disappoint
Was so excited to try this. Plugged it in and nothing. The power light turns on indicating it's getting power but it won't turn on. Very disappointing.

I bought this particular one after looking at many YouTube reviews, and the reviews on here.. Anddd IT'S PINK😍.. Comes with a free nail tool kit AND the drills.. Not to mention the nice little storage bag.. Im a beginner and wanted a drill that gets the job done.. Has power but not too much that I could hurt myself (I never drilled my nails myself.. Always went to professionals to have my nails done).. And this is PERFECT.. I feel professional doing my nails.. But I can't hurt myself too bad ..

reviews.t: I love love love this nail drill
reviews.x: I love love love this nail drill....I am a professional nail tech and its very easy to use i hardly hear any noise when its working. i would recommend this drill to every nail tech i know. Am definitely buying another one this week. Thank You Morpilot. Thumbs up.

I didn't even know this even existed until I saw it being used in a YouTube video. I notice that is currently out of stock. No wonder! This tool has power, is easy to use, and inexpensively priced. I have a sad, damaged toenail that I saw someone on YouTube re-form with one of these drills. So, I was very excited to receive this drill this evening. I was not disappointed! My jinkie toenail looks so much better. I also used a callous remover drill bit to get rid of some rough, dry skin around my

I’m a total beginner but found the drill very easy to use with a great variety of tools. I’ve only used it once but very impressed with quality. Came with handy illustrated guide for how to use each piece.

reviews.t: Professional quality! A small tool with power
reviews.x: This e-file is very powerful! It is lightweight and easy to maneuver around your nail and cuticle. It also is very quiet. It’s tough enough for me to file down acrylics, with all the assorted file bits, it is very versatile.  A wide range of speed and forward/reverse option depending on angle you need.

reviews.t: Ladies please don’t waste your money!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:d354ebfd805e62302642fad1c8bcfc8f]] Omg! I got this yesterday and used it once. I try it again and it doesn’t work smh Will be returning asap

This is probably my third drill I've ever owned and I will say it is by far my favorite. Even though this drill seems like it would be lightweight it is not. This drill has all the pieces you could possibly need for doing your nails. It has a little section where you can control the speed on the cord. All the attachments have Direction so you know which piece is for what. Definitely purchase this item.

After reading several reviews on this product I was very skeptical to purchase it. I am very happy to say that I'm glad i ignored them because I absolutely love this Nail Drill. It was very easy to assemble, has great speed and it came in my favorite color. My days of paying for a mani/pedi are OVER!!! Absolutely hands down love it!!!

I'm totally bummed! Just like some others experienced, mine didn't even turn on. I plugged it in & the light was on but it wouldn't work. What a bummer. I suppose I'll be purchasing a different brand.

reviews.t: ... wanted this item for the price point and the good reviews, but upon opening it did not work
reviews.x: I really wanted this item for the price point and the good reviews, but upon opening it did not work. Disappointed because I really like the size. This seller did not offer exchanges, only amazon credit or refunds.

reviews.t: Not very powerful. I guess it does the job ...
reviews.x: Not very powerful. I guess it does the job for the price! It took roughly 45 minutes to drill off gel polish, typically a 5 minute job!

reviews.t: I'm sure it will work beautifully if only a Manual had been included
reviews.x: I'm sure it will work beautifully if only a Manual had been included.  I contacted customer service to advise them of this, no reply, nothing.  It's rather worthless as I have no idea which drill is to be used for what is needed. I now have a Manuel for the use of the Nail Drill.  I'm very, very happy. with it. It works beautifully.  The company was very concerned & rectified the problem.

I purchased this item in March 2018, and at first, I loved it.  It worked very well, however, after three months, it has stopped working. It has little to no power when you turn it on.  For the money, this item should definitely last more than a few months.  The nail drill is of no use to me now.  I'd like a replacement, but do not see where that is possible after 30 days. So in the end, a total waste of money!

I went to try this tool today and realized it came with a European power cord. All the pictures show a US power cord. I doubt everyone had this experience, but I can’t figure out how to get another cord without returning the whole item. I really needed to use this in the next two days. Very disappointed.

Obviously I am not a nail pro from the picture I attached, but I think the tool did a good enough job filing the nails into a narrow shape. Others have said it doesn't have a lot of power and it's true - if you want power, buy a Dremel if you want to shave your whole finger off. However, I think it has enough power to give you control of the tool without it flying out of your hands.  PROS: lightweight, quiet, RPM isn't crazy high  CONS: the off/on switch is on the cord and makes it too cumbersom

reviews.t: It was great, until it wasn't. Only used it 5 times.
reviews.x: Sadly, I have to give this drill only one star. I've only had it one month. I've used it maybe 5 times and now it's not working at all. Up until now it was working great. I wasnt expecting it to last for years, given the low price, but I believe it should have lasted more than 5 uses. Very disappointed.
Easy to use, this drill exceeded my expectations. I am not a professional nail tech by any means I do my own nails as a hobby. This drill worked great for the powder gel nail dips.

reviews.t: I was so excited for the drill to arrive. ...

Lightweight, cool to the touch, easy to use, ergonomic, and pink! What's not to love? The drill has varying speeds controlled by a dial and can alternate direction with a switch.  It would be nice if the drill contained at least one heavy duty carbide bit, most of the bits are for polishing and are very, very fine. It would also be nice to have the shaft width printed on the drill or packaging, as I had to open this link to find out (3/32 if anyone is wondering).  I haven't used the nail care gi

Was using this product every two weeks to do my nails. Loved it because it worked well for the first 2 times I used it! However, halfway through doing my nails today, it stopped working. There is a red light indicating that it’s receiving power, but it won’t work at all. Nothing like being halfway through your nails and not being able to finish. This may be a cheaper option for some people, but don’t bother wasting your money. In the long run you’ll just have to buy a different one
